stages.title: Interpret and acknowledge
requirements: Preserve original author/source, explain the understood need and search for related requests. A submission is not work admission.
Interpret dissatisfaction, praise or observations without requiring a proposed fix; answer, track, consolidate, decline or admit useful work with a reason.

stages.title: Clarify only consequential gaps
requirements: Keep plain-text feedback valid. Ask only for information needed to answer or authorize the affected action; independent work can continue.

stages.title: Record disposition and covering outcomes
requirements: Explain the decision/reason under existing authority. Preserve shared/split outcomes and declined or remaining scope; do not mechanically create work tickets.

stages.title: Verify and report the result
requirements: Distinguish an answer, a tracked request, implementation progress and actual delivered availability. Report failures, blockers and limits honestly.

stages.title: Accept follow-up
requirements: Retain the source issue and respond to corrections or post-closure feedback without erasing earlier results.
